title: Over 10 million streams globally
detail: Including more than 1.2 million for “Hypnotize” and 1.25 million for “We Don't Care”.

title: 290,000+ Shazams to date
detail: “Hypnotize” ranked among the Top 20 most Shazamed songs in South Africa.

title: Major festivals
detail: Ultra South Africa, H2O Johannesburg and Cape Town, Secrets of Summer and Lentedag, plus shows in over 7 countries.

title: Played alongside
detail: Victor Ruiz, Raxon, Dense & Pika, Matt Sassari, &Lez, Kasango and Vanco.

title: Collaborations and remixes
detail: TiMO ODV, Ziyon, Ryan Murgatroyd, Kylah Jasmine, Jethro Tait and Apple Gule.

title: The State of the Arts
detail: Directed and produced a documentary on lockdown's impact on South Africa's live entertainment sector.
